statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has symptoms consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has transient neurological symptoms suggestive of a transient cerebral ischemic attack
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring, CPT 93229, was ordered
The service was ordered to correlate intermittent arrhythmic events with clinical symptoms
The service was ordered to assess for potential embolic sources or hemodynamic instability
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The service was denied because required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained prior to the date of service
